run_bulk_pixel_onboarding: run the bulk pixel onboarding CLI tool with hostname, client_id, client_secret, and tenant_id arguments
get_access_token: fetch an OAuth access token using client credentials grant from the token endpoint
add_pixel: add a new pixel to a tenant via the GraphQL capig mutation endpoint
read_access_tokens: read business access tokens from a CSV file and return them as a dictionary
review_main: review the main entry point that orchestrates bulk pixel onboarding from CSV pixel and token files
